summary: Independently rebuilt the md5-verified BG oracle and adversarially audited the two newest load-bearing results: student-1's compact pole part P_pole and student-2's denominator reduction (Delta=C^3, D_min=C) plus the linear pair-wall jump. Reimplemented P_pole, C, Delta, d_T and the two-minus A_4/A_5 formula from the written derivations (no student evaluator imported). All independently checkable claims reproduced EXACTLY. P_pole is correct and denominator-removing in ALL 8 chambers (student-1 had tested only 4 sorted words); Delta=C^3, 1/d_T=(w_m+w_r)/(2C), D_min=C genuine per analytic cell, and the pair-wall jump is order exactly 1 with limit 12622720/27 (cubic brick ruled out) all confirmed. Still NO complete compact A_6: the polynomial-spline remainder R = A_6/i - P_pole (degree-6 orbit brick H_mp) is unknown. Two structural caveats surfaced: every real C=0 point is a triple-coincidence wall where residues cancel (A_6/i finite -> no approachable real pole; C is a per-cell denominator only), and A_6's analytic cell structure is finer than the 8-word selector (finer Q_T=0 and q_mp=0 walls).

gaps_found.text: No complete compact closed-form A_6 yet. Pole half solved+compact (P_pole), denominator reduced to C (deg 3), but the polynomial-spline remainder R_spline = A_6/i - P_pole (degree-8 dual-S3 spline; only known handle is sum_{m,p}(q_mp)_+ H_mp with deg H_mp=6 UNKNOWN) is not reduced to a human-readable expression. Deliverable does not exist.

'Genuine real factorization pole' language (F9/round-2 premise) is imprecise: every real C=0 point is a triple mixed-pair coincidence where diverging channel terms cancel, so A_6/i and P_pole stay finite (removable). A_6/i has no approachable real pole; C is a genuine denominator only per analytic cell. The decomposition is still sound (this cancellation is why R is a pure polynomial spline).

A_6's analytic cell structure is finer than the 8-word selector: within one 8-word chamber A_6/i still switches branch at Q_T=0 (triple sign) and q_mp=0 (pair sign) walls. Holding only the 8-word fixed gave a spurious degree-17 line interpolant; holding the full pair/triple signature fixed gave a clean degree-9 B=C*A6/i. R_spline is not merely eight polynomials.
BG is exactly singular (SIGFPE) at on-shell wall/pole points; 6/246 sampled nondegenerate points were skipped. Final evaluator + verification must use two-sided limits at walls.
